messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's Spring Huddle — thanks everyone who joined. Posting the recording and a short list of takeaways + actionable items. Please add any Qs below if you want them addressed in the exec AMA tomorrow. :seedling:

Jake (CEO): Great session — appreciate the hard work on Dedicated GA. Two quick asks: 1) sync on SLAs and 2) a short blurb for customers about the GA windows.

Priya (Head of Product): Uploading the slides here: https://redwood.internal/spr-huddle/slides.pdf — see slides 6–8 for rollout timeline and canary plan.

Omar (Eng/SRE): Incident summary we mentioned is at https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-04-12-kvcache — TL;DR: regression fixed by patch v1.12.3, autoscale tweak rolled out. No customer impact after 10:23 PT.

Victor (Sales): FYI for AE team: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb re: Dedicated GA and share by EOD. @Priya can you confirm the recommended messaging?

Priya (Head of Product): Yep — I'll post a short 3-line snippet in #sales-channel after lunch.

Maya (Design): Recording looks good — one note: can we add captions before we share externally? Accessibility is important.

Elena (People Ops): Recording (internal): https://redwood.internal/recordings/spring-huddle-1812345678.mp4 — captions are queued (should be ready in ~4 hours).

hr-bot: Reminder: New PTO accrual policy goes into effect May 1. See the HR page for details: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-update.

Jake (CEO): Two highlights I asked the team to call out: 1) Serving throughput improvements — median latency down 18% on long prompts; 2) Customer uptake of Dedicated trial > 2x forecast. Huge credit to runtime and platform teams.

Omar (Eng/SRE): Action items I heard: A) postmortem doc for the KV cache regression (link above) B) autoscaler metrics dashboard share C) follow-up on rollout rollback playbook. I'll drive A + B.

Victor (Sales): +1 on the blurb. Also: can we get a one-pager with feature matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) so AEs can map to customer profiles?

Priya (Head of Product): Adding a one-pager to the product toolkit repo — will ping when done.

Elena (People Ops): Q&A collection: drop any questions here or add to the Google form: https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-qa. We'll consolidate and prioritize for the exec AMA.

Maya (Design): Quick UX ask for team leads — can we make the slides downloadable as PNGs for quick embeds?

Elena (People Ops): Noted — will ask comms to export PNGs and post in the wiki space.

Jake (CEO): If anyone missed it, please watch the recording before tomorrow's AMA. Thanks everyone — short wins, big momentum. :tada:
_meta: Created for internal all-hands follow-up: agenda, recording link, takeaways, Q&A collection. Thread intentionally concise to reflect Slack style.
